steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Apply the required tenant configuration for vendor addition during event creation.
Apply the specified stage configuration before creating the draft.
Give the draft a known title so it can be reopened from Drafts.
Create an eRFX draft containing the RFQ tab under test and the required technical stage.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
Add a line item so the RFQ stage has its pricing content.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
Save the configured eRFX project as an unpublished draft.
Confirm saving the draft did not produce an application error.
Open the Events list to retrieve the saved draft.
Confirm the saved eRFX draft is listed in Drafts.
Open the specific saved draft; drafts reopen on their create screen.
Open the RFQ tab whose behavior is being tested.
Verify that opening or remaining on the RFQ tab produces no error.
